description: Team-and-skill edition pack for careers inside large institutions -- hospitals, universities, correctional facilities, corporate campuses, and facilities/maintenance teams. Bundles (1) field how-tos for institutional craft: work-order triage, maintenance improvisation with constrained resources, shift handoffs; (2) career-skill entries for refining the craft and leveling up: documentation, mentoring, promotion cases, bureaucracy navigation; (3) team-play entries for coordinating crews under pressure: short-staffed huddles, flood response, incident command, on-call design. Every entry carries compliance-aware stop conditions that name the regulatory line -- life-safety systems, licensed trades, and code boundaries are never improvised past.

track_emphasis.improve: primary -- triage, documentation, career leveling, mentoring, and the compliance-aware stop culture are all improvement of craft and career
track_emphasis.improvise: primary -- Sidewinder doctrine core: constrained resources, temp fixes, short crews, and no-forklift moves
track_emphasis.restore: primary -- the maintenance trade is repair: drains, valves, breakers, doors, HVAC, leaks
track_emphasis.build: secondary -- shift kits, cannibalization boards, spare-parts bibles, temp lighting rigs
track_emphasis.combine: secondary -- multi-trade coordination, cannibalization, mentoring as knowledge-combining
track_emphasis.create: tertiary -- SOPs, on-call rotations, promotion cases, incident-command structures, red-line posters

safety_posture: Compliance-aware: every entry names the regulatory line in its stop conditions. Never improvise past life-safety systems (fire alarm/suppression NFPA 72/13, fire doors NFPA 80, medical gas NFPA 99, elevators, boilers/pressure vessels, emergency circuits), licensed-trade boundaries (electrical panel interiors, refrigerant/EPA 608, asbestos/lead abatement), or institutional policy (key control, fall protection, confined space, lockout/tagout). Temporary fixes are labeled, dated, and scheduled for permanent repair -- never silent, never on life-safety.
notes_for_main_builder: 40 entries: 20 field how-tos, 11 career-skill, 9 team-play. Domain is 'general' per coordinator spec (institutional spans hospitals, universities, corrections, campuses). Prerequisites form a DAG within the pack, all resolving locally. Open question: whether team-play entries should later carry a team-size hint field for the platform's team runtime.
